AskRequest.description:
The body `useChat` posts: the chat so far, plus Plumbline's own controls. Each
question is answered on its own; earlier turns are not used yet.

CacheMode.description:
How model calls use cache/: replay reads only (tests, the hub, CI); record calls the
model on a miss and writes the recording; live calls on a miss and writes nothing.

DemoTier.description:
The degradation ladder: full (premium route on), free (free-tier models only),
static (the static export serving stored answers).
DemoTier.title: DemoTier

FeedbackRequest.description:
A reader's verdict on one answer. The note is free text and may hold personal data:
it is stored, never sent to a model, and never logged.
FeedbackRequest.title: FeedbackRequest

JobEventView.description: One step of a job: the data of each event on its stream.
JobEventView.title: JobEventView

ProvisionStatus.description:
Validity of a provision on the edition's date. Colombian "Nota de vigencia" and
INEXEQUIBLE markers map onto these values; the original note is kept in validity_note.

TraceSummary.description: What the answer cost and where it came from (the model-and-tier badge).

The answer as an AI SDK UI message stream (server-sent events).
